integrity: The proof is an exact operator argument plus a one-dimensional symbolic counterexample; no numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The correction is specific to the definition with a freely chosen invertible preconditioner and does not alter the standard fixed-mixed-operator notion of approximate duality.

The exact-dual transformation in Corollary 3.8(i) remains valid when the mixed operator is invertible; the rejected part is the unconditional Neumann-series representation and the claimed ordinary approximate duality.
title: Adjustable preconditioning collapses approximate controlled \(g\)-duality to exact \(g\)-duality
